[32m+[m[32m// 读取串口配置，创建串口对象，连接收到数据后的处理函数，最后打开串口。[m
[32m+[m[32mbool HeadlessRunner::setupSerial()[m
[32m+[m[32m{[m
[32m+[m[32m    QSettings settings(configPath_, QSettings::IniFormat);[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m    const bool enabled =[m
[32m+[m[32m        settings.value("serial/enabled", false).toBool();[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m    if (!enabled)[m
[32m+[m[32m    {[m
[32m+[m[32m        return true;[m
[32m+[m[32m    }[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m    const QString device =[m
[32m+[m[32m        settings.value("serial/device").toString().trimmed();[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m    if (device.isEmpty())[m
[32m+[m[32m    {[m
[32m+[m[32m        qCritical() << "[SERIAL] Device path is empty";[m
[32m+[m[32m        return false;[m
[32m+[m[32m    }[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m    serialTargetSpeedMps_ = appConfig_.targetSpeed;[m
[32m+[m[32m    serialPort_ = new SerialPort(this);[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m    connect(serialPort_, &SerialPort::lineReceived,[m
[32m+[m[32m            this, &HeadlessRunner::handleSerialLine);[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m    connect(serialPort_, &SerialPort::lineRejected,[m
[32m+[m[32m            this, [this](const QString &reason)[m
[32m+[m[32m            { serialPort_->sendLine([m
[32m+[m[32m                  QByteArray("ERR ") + reason.toUtf8()); });[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m    connect(serialPort_, &SerialPort::portError,[m
[32m+[m[32m            this, [](const QString &message)[m
[32m+[m[32m            { qWarning().noquote()[m
[32m+[m[32m                  << "[SERIAL] Closed:" << message; });[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m    QString error;[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m    if (!serialPort_->openDevice(device, error))[m
[32m+[m[32m    {[m
[32m+[m[32m        qCritical().noquote()[m
[32m+[m[32m            << "[SERIAL] Cannot open" << device << error;[m
[32m+[m[32m        return false;[m
[32m+[m[32m    }[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m    qInfo().noquote()[m
[32m+[m[32m        << "[SERIAL] Opened:" << device;[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m    return true;[m
[32m+[m[32m}[m

[32m+[m[32m// 收到一条完整串口命令后，判断要做什么，执行操作，再给对端回复。[m
[32m+[m[32mvoid HeadlessRunner::handleSerialLine([m
[32m+[m[32m    const QByteArray &line)[m
[32m+[m[32m{[m
[32m+[m[32m    if (shutdownStarted_)[m
[32m+[m[32m    {[m
[32m+[m[32m        return;[m
[32m+[m[32m    }[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m    const SerialCommand command =[m
[32m+[m[32m        parseSerialCommand(line.toStdString());[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m    switch (command.type)[m
[32m+[m[32m    {[m
[32m+[m[32m    case CommandType::Ping:[m
[32m+[m[32m        serialPort_->sendLine("PONG");[m
[32m+[m[32m        break;[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m    case CommandType::SetSpeed:[m
[32m+[m[32m        serialTargetSpeedMps_ = command.speedMps;[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m        simulationEngine_->setTargetVehicleSpeed([m
[32m+[m[32m            command.speedMps);[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m        serialPort_->sendLine([m
[32m+[m[32m            QByteArray("OK SET_SPEED ") +[m
[32m+[m[32m            QByteArray::number(command.speedMps, 'f', 3));[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m        qInfo() << "[SERIAL] Target speed:"[m
[32m+[m[32m                << command.speedMps << "m/s";[m
[32m+[m[32m        break;[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m    case CommandType::GetState:[m
[32m+[m[32m        if (!haveSerialState_)[m
[32m+[m[32m        {[m
[32m+[m[32m            serialPort_->sendLine("ERR state-not-ready");[m
[32m+[m[32m            break;[m
[32m+[m[32m        }[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m        serialPort_->sendLine([m
[32m+[m[32m            QByteArray("STATE target_speed_mps=") +[m
[32m+[m[32m            QByteArray::number([m
[32m+[m[32m                serialTargetSpeedMps_, 'f', 3) +[m
[32m+[m[32m            " speed_mps=" +
